# Scope of the Base Problem

This is a deliberately limited average direct-shear check. The stated 640 MPa value is the nominal minimum tensile yield strength for property class 8.8; the shear-yield estimate uses the von Mises relation. It is not a certified capacity for the photographed hardware. A complete connection design must also address eccentric bolt-group action, bolt tension, bearing, tear-out, prying, threads in the shear plane, preload and slip, fatigue and impact dynamics, wall anchors, and the actual bracket geometry.
